policy.decision: Person Domain v2 Review Unit 07. Reclassify one bounded 8-Person economic/social-systems boundary slice from legacy knowledge into commerce, culture, and technology. Every write requires live Production previous_domain=knowledge; any drift fails closed.

review_scope.selection_rule: Use a deliberately smaller boundary unit to test the v2 separation between economic thought (commerce), social/historical thought (culture), and applied industrial systems (technology) without forcing ambiguous cases into a larger batch.

entries.basis: V2 commerce explicitly includes economic systems and economic thought when those are the representative historical identity. Smith's durable global identity is as a foundational political economist and author of The Wealth of Nations, despite his moral-philosophy career.
V2 commerce includes economic thought. Ricardo is represented primarily as a classical economist whose major contributions concern political economy, trade, rent, value, and distribution.
V2 commerce includes economic systems and economic thought. Keynes is the namesake and foundational theorist of Keynesian macroeconomics and is represented historically above all as an economist.
V2 commerce includes economic thought. Friedman is represented by monetary economics, consumption analysis, stabilization policy, and the Chicago school of economics.
V2 commerce includes economic governance and economic systems when representative. Ostrom's prize-recognized contribution is the analysis of economic governance, especially the commons.

V2 culture includes philosophy, history, and social thought. Marx's economic analysis is central, but his representative identity spans philosophy of history, social and political philosophy, ideology critique, and a general theory of society; the broader humanities/social-thought identity is more faithful than treating him as an economist alone.

V2 culture includes history and social thought. Ibn Khaldun is represented principally as a historian and theorist of society, state formation, group solidarity, and historical change rather than as a specialist economist.

V2 technology includes engineering and applied systems. Taylor was a mechanical engineer whose scientific-management methods applied engineering-style measurement, process design, and efficiency systems to industrial work; his representative identity is applied industrial technology/engineering rather than abstract scholarship.
